This 2013 Ford F-150 XL with 4WD represents a solid work truck built for performance and capability in challenging conditions. Its white exterior and sturdy construction make it a reliable choice for those seeking durability and commanding road presence.

- 5.0L V8 Flex Fuel engine with 6-speed automatic transmission
- 4-wheel drive capability
- Trailer tow package with class IV trailer hitch receiver and 7-pin wiring harness

- Power locks with autolock and keyless entry key fob
- Power windows and illuminated entry
- Air conditioning
- Electronic stability control and traction control

- Chrome front and rear bumpers

- Cloth 40/20/40 front seats
- Full suite of safety features including dual front and side impact airbags

The F-150 XL comes equipped with the Mid Equipment Group, which provides essential comfort and convenience features while maintaining practical truck functionality. Its 5.0L V8 engine with flex fuel capability delivers the power needed for hauling and towing, achieving 14 MPG in the city and 19 MPG on the highway. The truck's 4-wheel drive system offers enhanced traction and stability in various weather and terrain conditions, while the upgraded radiator and auxiliary transmission oil cooler ensure reliable operation under demanding use.

Safety and control are prioritized through features like electronic stability control, traction control, ABS brakes, and a comprehensive airbag system designed to protect occupants. The SelectShift automatic transmission gives drivers the ability to manually shift gears when needed, providing greater command over the vehicle's performance.

The trailer tow package makes this F-150 XL a versatile option for those requiring hauling capabilities. With the class IV trailer hitch receiver and proper wiring harness in place, this truck stands ready to handle the work you need done.

Inside, the SYNC system offers intuitive voice-activated control over communications, entertainment, and vehicle functions through Bluetooth connectivity and USB compatibility, keeping your focus on the road. MyKey technology allows you to program customized vehicle settings, including top speed limiters and audio volume limits.

This F-150 XL delivers the straightforward capability and reliable performance you expect from a truck built by Ford. We invite you to experience it firsthand—contact us or visit our showroom to discuss how this vehicle can serve your needs.

This 2013 Ram 1500 Sport in striking red delivers the capability and comfort you expect from a full-size pickup truck. Powered by the legendary HEMI 5.7L V8 engine with Multi Displacement technology, this truck combines performance with practical efficiency. The 4WD system provides confident traction in various conditions, while the 6-speed automatic transmission ensures smooth power delivery.

The Sport Premium Group elevates your driving experience with a premium audio system featuring 9 amplified speakers and a subwoofer, bringing your favorite music to life. The Uconnect 8.4AN infotainment system integrates an 8.4" touch screen, GPS navigation, and SiriusXM services, keeping you connected and informed on every drive. Dual-zone automatic air conditioning maintains personalized comfort for driver and passengers alike.

Practical features make this truck ready for work and weekend adventures. The spray-in bedliner protects your truck bed, while the Class IV receiver hitch enables towing capability. The 32-gallon fuel tank supports extended driving ranges, and the 3.55 axle ratio enhances towing performance. Modern safety technology includes the ParkView rear back-up camera and ParkSense rear parking assist system, making parking and maneuvering easier and safer.

Inside, comfortable cloth bucket seats with a split-folding rear seat offer flexibility for passengers and cargo. The leather steering wheel and power driver seat provide quality and adjustability, while convenient features like the garage door transmitter and multiple storage solutions enhance daily usability.

The Sport Performance Hood and polished aluminum wheels contribute to an aggressive, intentional appearance that reflects the truck's capable nature. Heated power door mirrors and auto-dimming rear-view mirror add functional sophistication to your driving experience.

Serving Raleigh, Durham, and the entire Triangle, Westgate Mitsubishi delivers a strong lineup of new Mitsubishis plus a large selection of used cars for every budget, all with a fast, transparent buying process.

As much as we like satisfying customers, we like keeping them even more.What Is a Subaru Manufacturer Buyback Vehicle?A Subaru Manufacturer Buyback Vehicle is a car that Subaru of America has repurchased from a customer. This typically happens when a customer experiences problems with a new vehicle. In some instances, state law requires Subaru to buy back the car due to a recurring issue. In other cases, Subaru opts to buy back the vehicle as a gesture of goodwill for valued customers. After Subaru corrects the issues that led to the buyback, these vehicles are offered exclusively for sale to Subaru dealers.Reasons for BuybackMany buybacks are triggered by relatively minor issues. Sometimes, the underlying reasons are not actual mechanical or safety problems, but rather characteristics of the vehicle that certain owners may not prefer. Subaru acquires these cars from across the country, and some states have lower legal thresholds for requiring manufacturers to repurchase vehicles. For transparency, Subaru provides a signed disclosure explaining the specific reason each vehicle was bought back.Why Does Bloomington Acura Subaru Sell Buyback Vehicles?Bloomington Acura Subaru offers these vehicles because they represent an excellent value. The dealership acquires them at a lower cost from Subaru, as many other dealers are unwilling to manage the required disclosure process. Savings from this reduced purchase price are passed on to customers.Ensuring Vehicle QualityTo ensure the vehicles are properly repaired, Bloomington Acura Subaru researches each vehicles service history to review the repairs performed. Additionally, our certified technicians thoroughly inspect and test-drive the vehicles to confirm that the issues have been resolved.What Do Buybacks Say About Subaru QualitySubaru sells over 700,000 new vehicles annually in the United States, yet only a few hundred cars are bought back each year. This small number indicates that Subaru maintains a high level of quality, ranking among the best in the auto industry. Reputable sources like Consumer Reports consistently praise Subarus reliability and overall quality.Vehicle History and DisclosuresThe buyback status of these vehicles appears on vehicle history reports such as Carfax and AutoCheck. Bloomington Acura Subaru provides a copy of the Carfax report with each purchase for full transparency.Financing, Warranty and Service ContractsBuyback vehicles come with all the same warranties as Subarus that have not been repurchased. They are also eligible for comprehensive extended service contracts. These vehicles qualify for the Luther Advantage Program, and their buyback history does not affect finance rates from Bloomington Acura Subarus lending partners.Are These Cars Considered Lemons?Technically, these vehicles may be classified as lemons, as their history is labeled Returned to manufacturer under lemon law or other proceeding. Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
Technology and Telematics
  • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.

This 2019 Subaru Outback 2.5i Limited in striking red combines practical versatility with refined comfort, offering the dependability and capability you need for everyday driving and weekend adventures alike.

- Power Moonroof with auto-open and close functionality
- Subaru STARLINK 8.0" Multimedia Navigation System with voice controls
- LED Steering Responsive Headlights with High Beam Assist
- Reverse Automatic Braking for added safety awareness
- harman/kardon Surround Sound Speaker System with 12 speakers
- Heated front and rear seats for year-round comfort
- All-Weather Floor Liners and Splash Guards for protection
- Auto-Dimming Rear View Mirror with HomeLink and compass
- Perforated leather-trimmed seating surfaces
- SiriusXM All Access Radio with Traffic and Travel Link
- Four-wheel independent suspension for smooth handling
- 18" alloy wheels
- Roof rack for expanded cargo capacity
- Smartphone integration with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Rear Seat Back Protector and matching Rear Bumper Cover

The 2.5L four-cylinder engine with CVT Lineartronic transmission and all-wheel drive delivers responsive performance while achieving an impressive 25 city and 32 highway miles per gallon. This powertrain provides the balance of efficiency and capability that Outback owners expect, whether navigating city streets or exploring off-the-beaten-path destinations.

The Limited trim presents a thoughtfully appointed interior where comfort takes priority. Heated front bucket seats with memory settings ensure personalized support for your drives, while dual front zone automatic climate control maintains your preferred temperature throughout the cabin. The perforated leather-trimmed surfaces add a touch of refinement, and the well-organized interior features a front center armrest with storage, multiple cupholders, and convenient overhead and dome lighting accents.

Safety features are comprehensively integrated into this vehicle's design. Subaru's EyeSight Driver Assist Technology components include High Beam Assist and Reverse Automatic Braking, which work alongside the vehicle information display to keep you informed. Electronic stability control, traction control, and four-wheel disc ABS brakes provide confidence in various driving conditions. The comprehensive airbag system includes dual front impact, dual front side impact, and overhead airbags to protect occupants.

Technology seamlessly integrates into your driving experience through the STARLINK 8.0" navigation system with its high-resolution touchscreen. Voice-activated controls allow hands-free operation, while Bluetooth connectivity enables audio streaming and hands-free phone communication. SiriusXM satellite radio with Traffic and Travel Link subscriptions keeps you entertained and informed on longer journeys. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto smartphone integration ensure your devices work intuitively with the vehicle's systems.

With 62,396 miles on the odometer, this Outback remains well within its prime, backed by Subaru's reputation for long-term reliability and durability. The combination of practical features, safety technology, and driver-focused comfort makes this a vehicle that adapts to your lifestyle while maintaining the rugged capability that defines the Outback lineage. We invite you to schedule a time to experience this vehicle in person and discover why the Outback continues to be the trusted choice for those seeking capability without compromise.

The system includes SiriusXM satellite radio and a CD player for multiple audio options. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls and a trip computer add to the user-friendly design.

Practical conveniences define the Outback experience. The power rear gate with automatic close and height memory feature makes loading and unloading remarkably easy, while the roof rack expands your storage possibilities. This 2019 Subaru Outback 3.6R Limited delivers the capability and comfort you need for every journey, whether navigating daily commutes or exploring beyond the pavement.

- Power Moonroof with auto-open/close and tinted glass
- Subaru STARLINK 8.0" Multimedia Navigation System with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto

Safety is paramount in this model, featuring dual front and side impact airbags, electronic stability control, four-wheel disc ABS brakes, traction control, and low tire pressure monitoring. The reverse camera provides added confidence when backing up.

This Outback combines the practicality of an all-wheel-drive wagon with features that make every drive more connected and enjoyable. We invite you to visit our showroom to see this vehicle in person and experience what makes it stand out.

description: Discover the 2019 Subaru Outback Premium, a versatile SUV that combines rugged capability with refined comfort. Featuring a striking Abyss Blue Pearl exterior and a sleek Slate Black interior, this used vehicle has traveled 79,213 miles, offering a reliable option for drivers seeking adventure and everyday reliability. Powered by a 2.5-liter naturally aspirated four-cylinder engine producing 175 horsepower and 174 lb-ft of torque, it pairs with an automatic CVT transmission and standard all-wheel-drive, ensuring confident handling in diverse conditions. The Outbackas fuel efficiency shines with 25 mpg in the city and 32 mpg on the highway, making it a practical choice for both commuting and longer trips. Its spacious four-door layout comfortably seats five, making it suitable for families or outdoor enthusiasts alike. This Subaru Outback Premium is packed with features designed for convenience, safety, and connectivity. Adaptive cruise control, lane keep assist, collision warning, and a backup camera work seamlessly to enhance safety on every journey. Apple CarPlay, Bluetooth, satellite radio readiness, and an 8-inch touchscreen infotainment system provide entertainment and connectivity options, while heated seats and fog lights add comfort and visibility. The vehicle also includes practical upgrades such as All-Weather Floor Mats, a Rear Bumper Cover, Rear Seat Back Protector, and Splash Guards, along with advanced side mirror signals, a power rear gate with height memory, and rear cross traffic alert. These features make this Outback a well-rounded SUV ready to meet your daily needs and outdoor adventures. 2019 Subaru Outback Safety and Security Features This vehicle offers a comprehensive array of safety features including dual front seat cushion airbags and 4-wheel anti-lock braking system for enhanced protection. Power door locks with auto-locking and anti-lockout functions ensure security, while cornering brake control improves handling during turns. Hill descent assist provides added confidence on steep descents, and an electronic parking brake with auto-off adds convenience and safety, making this Outback a dependable choice for safety-conscious drivers. 2019 Subaru Outback Entertainment and Technology Features Equipped with an 8-inch touch screen display, this Outback provides intuitive access to entertainment and connectivity. It supports MySubaru app compatibility and Wi-Fi hotspot capability, allowing seamless device integration. The audio system includes six speakers, HD radio, and voice-operated radio and electronic messaging assistance, including a read function for convenience. Pandora internet radio and voice-controlled commands offer a variety of entertainment options, ensuring you stay connected and entertained on every drive. 2019 Subaru Outback Performance Features This Outback features a full-time all-wheel-drive system, delivering balanced traction and stability across diverse terrains. Its capable drivetrain ensures confident handling whether on paved roads or off-road trails, making it a reliable companion for outdoor adventures or daily commutes.

This 2022 Subaru Outback Limited in silver represents a capable all-wheel drive wagon designed for buyers who value practicality without compromising on comfort and technology.

- Power moonroof with heated steering wheel
- Subaru STARLINK 11.6" multimedia navigation system
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto smartphone integration
- DriverFocus driver monitoring system
- Harman/Kardon surround sound system with 12 speakers
- Heated front and rear seats
- Power driver and passenger seats with memory function
- Automatic temperature control with dual front zones
- Electronic stability control and traction control

- Rear parking camera

The powertrain combines a 2.5L 4-cylinder engine with Subaru's CVT Lineartronic transmission and standard all-wheel drive, delivering 26 miles per gallon in the city and 33 on the highway. This configuration balances efficiency with the reliability Subaru owners have come to expect.

The power moonroof floods the cabin with natural light, while the power liftgate adds convenience for loading cargo. Split folding rear seats provide flexibility for both passengers and cargo configurations.

Technology integration has been prioritized throughout. The STARLINK multimedia system offers voice-activated controls, navigation, and seamless connectivity through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. SiriusXM satellite radio comes with trial subscriptions for All Access, Traffic, and Travel Link services. The 576-watt Harman/Kardon system powers 12 speakers for quality audio throughout the cabin.

Safety features include dual front and side impact airbags, front and rear anti-roll bars, electronic stability control, automatic high-beam headlights, and front fog lights. The DriverFocus driver monitoring system adds an additional layer of attentiveness. A rear parking camera supports your visibility when backing up or parking.

This Outback has passed our dealer inspection and features new brakes, confirming its mechanical readiness. We welcome all buyers to visit us for a complete walkthrough and test drive of this well-equipped Subaru.

description: Step into this sleek Steel Silver 2009 Subaru Impreza Wagon and prepare for the ride of your life. Powered by a vigorous 2.5L SOHC SMPI 16-valve 4-cyl boxer engine, this car is ready to take on any adventure you have in store. The 4-wheel anti-lock braking system (ABS) and brake assist provide additional peace of mind on the road.This 2009 Subaru Impreza Wagon comes with a Carfax report, so you can purchase with confidence knowing the vehicle's history. This 2024 Hyundai Elantra N Base delivers performance and practical features designed for drivers who value both capability and everyday functionality. With its 2.0L turbocharged engine paired with an 8-speed dual clutch transmission, this front-wheel-drive compact sedan combines efficiency with engaging driving dynamics.

- Bose AM/FM/HD/SXM Audio System
- Apple CarPlay & Android Auto
- Navigation System
- Power Moonroof
- N Light Heated Sport Bucket Seats with Leather-Trimmed w/Alcantara Inserts

The interior reflects thoughtful design with heated sport bucket seats featuring leather trim with Alcantara inserts, providing comfort during daily commutes and longer drives. Dual front zone climate control ensures personalized comfort for both driver and passenger, while the power moonroof adds an open, airy feel to the cabin. The Bose audio system delivers quality sound whether you're enjoying SiriusXM satellite radio or your personal playlists through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration.

Safety remains a priority with dual front impact airbags, front and rear side impact airbags, overhead airbags, and occupant sensing technology. Brake assist, electronic stability control, and traction control work together to help maintain composure in various driving conditions. The exterior parking camera provides visibility when reversing, and an emergency communication system offers added peace of mind.

Practical features enhance ownership experience, including cargo side bins and a cargo net for securing items, plus a first aid kit for emergencies. The trunk includes a cargo hook for additional organization, while heated door mirrors and automatically adjusting headlights improve visibility during challenging weather. Other conveniences include remote keyless entry, a leather steering wheel, and a telescoping steering wheel for personalized positioning.

With an EPA-estimated 20 city mpg and 27 highway mpg, this Elantra N provides reasonable fuel economy for its class. The exterior presents a clean appearance in Atlas White, complemented by a body-color rear bumper applique and a spoiler that accentuate the N model's purposeful stance.

Whether you're navigating city streets or enjoying highway drives, this 2024 Hyundai Elantra N Base offers a well-rounded package of performance, comfort, and reliability backed by Hyundai's reputation for value and quality.

The electric motor delivers quick acceleration and smooth handling, reflecting Tesla’s reputation for performance. This used vehicle combines eco-friendly driving with practical charging solutions, ensuring a dynamic and efficient driving experience.

This 2020 BMW 3 Series M340i xDrive delivers the performance and refinement you expect from BMW's sport sedan lineup. With 77,244 miles on the odometer, this black exterior beauty maintains its commanding presence and represents genuine value for those seeking a driver-focused luxury vehicle.

- Remote Engine Start
- 19" Double-Spoke Bi-Color Wheels with Run-Flat All-Season Tires
- Power Tailgate
- Harman/Kardon Surround Sound System
- Black Vernasca Leather Upholstery with Contrast Stitching
- Ambient Lighting
- Driving Assistance Professional Package with Active Lane Keeping and Active Cruise Control with Stop & Go
- Icon Adaptive LED Headlights with Laserlight
- Head-Up Display
- Heated Steering Wheel
- Heated Front Seats
- Gesture Control
- Parking Assistant Plus
- Navigation System with Live Cockpit Pro

The 3.0L inline-six engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission delivers responsive performance, achieving 22 mpg in the city and 30 mpg on the highway. The xDrive all-wheel-drive system provides confident handling in various conditions, while the sport-tuned suspension balances comfort with controlled agility on the road.

Inside, you'll find a driver-centric cabin designed with precision and purpose. The Vernasca leather upholstery with contrast stitching enhances the interior ambiance, complemented by ambient lighting that sets the tone for each drive. Power front seats with lumbar support and memory functions ensure personalized comfort for every journey, while the heated steering wheel and heated front seats add practical luxury during colder months.

Technology seamlessly integrates throughout the vehicle. The Head-Up Display presents essential information directly in your line of sight, while the navigation system with Live Cockpit Pro keeps you connected and informed. Apple CarPlay compatibility, Hands-Free Bluetooth, and the Harman/Kardon surround sound system create an engaging driving environment. BMW Assist eCall and ConnectedDrive Services provide security and connectivity when you need it.

The Driving Assistance Professional Package elevates your confidence on the road with Active Driving Assistant Pro, Active Cruise Control with Stop & Go capability, and Active Lane Keeping Assistant with side collision avoidance. Additional features include Lane Departure Warning, Frontal Collision Warning with City Collision Mitigation, and Cross-Traffic Alert, designed to support safer driving decisions.

Safety and convenience work together throughout this sedan. Electronic Stability Control, four-wheel independent suspension with speed-sensing steering, and a comprehensive airbag system provide foundational protection. The Icon Adaptive LED headlights with Laserlight and automatic high beams enhance visibility, while the Exterior Parking Camera Rear and Parking Assistant Plus simplify maneuvering in tight spaces.

Contact us today to experience the 2020 BMW 3 Series M340i xDrive firsthand. We're ready to discuss how this well-equipped luxury sport sedan can serve your driving needs.

That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
  • Brake assist - Stop right there. Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now! With brake assist, you will. - 2.5L 4-Cylinder Engine with eCVT Transmission
- 48 City / 47 Highway MPG
- Toyota Audio Multimedia with 12.3" Touchscreen
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Integration
- Automatic Temperature Control with Dual Front Zones
- Power Driver Seat with Telescoping Steering Wheel
- SiriusXM Satellite Radio
- Exterior Parking Camera with Rear View
- 18" Black-Finished Alloy Wheels
- Leather Steering Wheel and Shift Knob

This Camry SE arrives in Black, a classic color that maintains its appeal while resisting visible dust and minor imperfections. The sedan sits on 18" black-finished alloy wheels that provide a modern aesthetic without compromising the smooth, connected ride that the four-wheel independent suspension and speed-sensing steering deliver on both highway and city routes.

Inside, the cabin reflects Toyota's commitment to driver-focused engineering. The 12.3" touchscreen infotainment system supports both Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, keeping your smartphone content accessible without distraction. Dual front zone air conditioning ensures comfort for all occupants, while the power driver seat with multiple adjustment ranges allows you to find your ideal position. The leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob add tactile quality to daily interaction points, and telescoping steering adjustment lets you customize your driving position for comfort on any journey.

Safety systems are comprehensive and thoughtfully integrated. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, electronic stability control, and traction control work together to support confident handling in varied conditions. The exterior parking camera provides visual feedback when reversing, while Toyota Safety Connect offers emergency communication capabilities. Multiple airbags, including front, side, and overhead protection, surround occupants with passive safety features.

Fuel efficiency is a defining characteristic of this Camry SE, delivering 48 mpg in the city and 47 mpg on the highway. The 2.5L 4-cylinder engine paired with the eCVT transmission balances responsive performance with economical operation, which translates to fewer trips to the pump and lower fuel costs over time.

The driving experience benefits from well-considered details. Remote keyless entry, illuminated entry lighting, and delay-off headlights enhance convenience, while the trip computer and outside temperature display keep relevant information at your fingertips. Heated mirrors clear visibility in cold weather, and variably intermittent wipers adapt to rainfall patterns automatically.

The 2025 Toyota Camry SE represents a straightforward value proposition for drivers seeking a dependable midsize sedan with modern conveniences, efficient operation, and safety-focused design. Visit our showroom to experience the commanding visibility, responsive handling, and well-appointed interior that make the Camry SE a practical choice for your daily drives and weekend journeys.

Our clientele depend on us for Transparent Pricing, Convenience and, most importantly, Customer FIRST Service! Take this 2025 Honda Civic Hybrid Sport Touring for instance... One Owner! What this vehicle includes: Convenience
  • Distance pacing cruise control with traffic stop-go. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with Distance pacing cruise control with traffic stop-go, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and the vehicle ahead. It's stop/go feature automatically brings the vehicle to a stop if traffic stops and resumes distance pacing cruise when traffic starts to move again. Distance pacing cruise control with traffic stop-go, your ultimate co-pilot.
Safety and Security
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Rear collision mitigation - It has your back. Rear collision mitigation uses sensors to monitor the area behind you. If it senses an impending crash, it activates certain features to help prevent a collision or reduce the severity of it. Put your worries behind you with rear collision mitigation.
  • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
Technology and Telematics
  • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.
  • Apple CarPlay/Android Auto smart device wireless mirroring
  • Mobile hotspot - WiFi on the fly. Connect your devices to the Internet through your vehicle's private mobile hotspot and take the internet wherever your journey takes you, without eating up your data allowance. Find the hotspot with mobile hotspot.

Discover the practicality and efficiency of the 2025 Toyota Camry SE, a midsize sedan that combines thoughtful design with everyday dependability.

- Power tilt/slide moonroof for open-air comfort
- 12.3" touchscreen with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- Front dual-zone automatic temperature control
- Heated power door mirrors with turn signal indicators
- Rear-view camera with parking assist capability
- Leather-trimmed steering wheel and shift knob
- 18" black-finished alloy wheels
- Fully automatic headlights with auto high-beam capability
- Split-folding rear seat for flexible cargo space
- Front and rear reading lights for convenience
- SofTex and fabric seat trim
- Electronic stability and traction control
- SiriusXM satellite radio with 6-speaker audio system
- Safety Connect emergency communication system

The SE trim provides a well-balanced approach to ownership. Its gray exterior presents a refined appearance that works with virtually any setting, while the special color finish adds subtle distinction. The power tilt/slide moonroof brings natural light and ventilation to the cabin, enhancing the sense of openness during your daily commute or weekend drives.

Inside, you'll find thoughtfully placed features that make driving less complicated. The leather steering wheel and shift knob contribute to a more upscale feel, while the telescoping steering wheel and comprehensive seat adjustments ensure proper positioning for any driver. The rear seat center armrest and split-folding design provide flexibility for passengers and cargo in equal measure. Temperature control operates independently for front driver and passenger zones, allowing everyone to stay comfortable without compromise.

Technology integration centers on the 12.3" touchscreen multimedia system, which seamlessly connects with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. This connectivity keeps you informed and entertained without requiring complicated setup. The steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep common functions within easy reach, reducing distractions. SiriusXM satellite radio expands your entertainment options beyond traditional broadcast stations.

The 2.5L 4-cylinder engine paired with an eCVT transmission delivers efficiency that translates to real savings at the pump. You can expect to achieve 48 miles per gallon in city driving and 47 on the highway—exceptional numbers for a vehicle in this class. This efficiency doesn't come at the expense of capability, the independent four-wheel suspension and electronic stability control work together to deliver composed handling on various road surfaces.

Safety features throughout the Camry SE demonstrate Toyota's commitment to occupant protection. Dual front and side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags create multiple layers of protection. The electronic stability and traction control systems help maintain vehicle control in challenging conditions. Anti-lock brakes provide responsive stopping power, while the rear-view camera assists with parking maneuvers and backing safely. Safety Connect offers emergency communication capabilities through a trial subscription, providing additional peace of mind during your ownership.

This 2025 Camry SE represents an opportunity to own a dependable midsize sedan that prioritizes both practicality and comfort. We encourage you to visit our showroom and experience this vehicle firsthand.
